library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: All public classes live under the `...kafkaclients.common.v0_11.internal` package — this is an internal, non-API-stable shared module consumed by opentelemetry-kafka-clients-2.6, opentelemetry-kafka-clients-streams-0.11, and opentelemetry-spring-kafka-2.7. Write tests directly against these internal classes using Kafka's MockProducer/MockConsumer and plain ConsumerRecord/ProducerRecord/RecordHeaders instances (see tests/src/io.opentelemetry.instrumentation/opentelemetry-kafka-clients-2.6/2.28.1-alpha for the established pattern: KafkaTelemetry.create(OpenTelemetry.noop()) style, assertj-core assertions, no SDK span exporter wiring needed). No environment variables, system properties, or Docker services are required.
risks: The module's classes are explicitly named 'internal' by the upstream project and carry no API-stability guarantee; a future OpenTelemetry release could rename or remove them without notice.
If the generation agent instead resolves a different kafka-clients test version, verify MockConsumer/MockProducer constructor signatures still match (they have changed across major Kafka versions).
